notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact, a creature, and/or a land that can tap to produce at least {4}.
description:
Activate a mana-producing artifact, creature, and/or land by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping the mana-producing permanents and causing you to gain two life.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Teferi.
Repeat.
